title: Authoritative Mutation Scoring Policy & Aggregate Recalculation

existing_policy_documented.verbatim_docstring: Mutation score = killed / (killed + survived + timeout). Denominator excludes no_tests (no relevant test) and not_checked/suspicious (not evaluated). This matches the C42 baseline computation (4418 / (4418 + 4315 + 38) ~= 50.6%). Returns None when no mutant was scored (cannot claim a score).

killed.rationale: Mutant detected by the test suite — the definition of success.

survived.rationale: Mutant executed and NOT detected — a genuine scored failure.

timeout.rationale: Mutant executed and produced a decisive (non-terminating) outcome; counted as an evaluated non-kill. Included via SCORED_STATUSES.

no_tests.rationale: No relevant test exists, so the suite cannot be credited or blamed. Explicitly excluded by the docstring.

not_checked.rationale: Never executed — no authoritative result exists. Explicitly excluded as 'not evaluated'.

suspicious.rationale: Non-decisive outcome. Explicitly excluded as 'not evaluated'.

scored_statuses_constant.comment: Statuses that represent a mutant that was actually executed and decided.

accounting_invariant.identity: TOTAL = killed + survived + timeout + no_tests + not_checked + suspicious

gate_model.gate_a: Execution Integrity — did mutation testing actually execute?
gate_model.gate_b: Evidence Integrity — are all classifications accounted for (reconcile_counts + generated > 0)?
gate_model.gate_c: Quality Threshold — evaluated ONLY if A and B pass; otherwise 'NOT EVALUABLE'

policy_ambiguity_assessment.reason_not_material: All four engines now have not_checked = 0 and suspicious = 0, so every excluded-from-denominator category is either zero or negligible (no_tests = 4 across 2406 mutants). The score is therefore insensitive to the ambiguity.

identified_ambiguities.topic: Completeness is not encoded in the score itself
identified_ambiguities.detail: compute_score() returns a number whenever killed+survived+timeout > 0, even if a large not_checked population exists. A partial run therefore yields a plausible-looking score indistinguishable from a complete one. This is precisely how loan 84.2% and reconciliation 72.5% were previously reported alongside complete engines.
identified_ambiguities.smallest_recommended_clarification: Record an explicit completeness flag alongside every score, e.g. mutation_complete = (not_checked == 0 and suspicious == 0), and require any reported score to be labelled COMPLETE or PARTIAL. This adds a label; it does NOT change the formula or the threshold.
identified_ambiguities.note: MutationResult.evidence_complete already exists but is defined as (invariant_ok and generated > 0), which is TRUE for a truncated run. The recommendation is to strengthen the reported label, not to alter scoring.

identified_ambiguities.topic: timeout is scored but no_tests is not
identified_ambiguities.detail: timeout sits in the denominator while no_tests does not. This is a defensible and documented choice (timeout = executed-and-decided; no_tests = nothing to credit), but it is asserted in a docstring rather than in a project policy document.
identified_ambiguities.smallest_recommended_clarification: Promote the docstring rule to an explicit written policy statement. No numeric change.

policy_ambiguity_assessment.policy_changes_made_this_phase: NONE. The existing documented policy was applied verbatim via mutation_contract.compute_score().

definitions.raw_mutation_population: Every mutant generated for the engine's source scope (TOTAL).
definitions.evaluated_population: killed + survived + timeout — mutants that received an authoritative, decisive result.
definitions.complete_mutation_score: A score where EVERY eligible mutant received an authoritative result (not_checked = 0 AND suspicious = 0).
definitions.partial_mutation_score: A score computed while some mutants remain not_checked or otherwise unevaluated. Must never be presented as equivalent to a complete score.

reconciliation_engine.delta_vs_m9_c42_18: not_checked 266 -> 0; killed 74 -> 296; survived 28 -> 72; score 72.5 (PARTIAL) -> 80.4 (COMPLETE, now PASSES)

aggregate.method: population-weighted using authoritative counts; engine percentages were NOT averaged
aggregate.completeness_justification: not_checked = 0 and suspicious = 0 for ALL FOUR engines. Every eligible mutant received an authoritative result.
aggregate.naive_mean_note: Reported only to demonstrate it was NOT used; the population-weighted figure 81.8% is authoritative.

partial_vs_complete_ledger.phase_6_requirement: Do not use partial scores as final scores

verification.computed_with: runtime.foundation.verification.mutation_contract.compute_score() and reconcile_counts() — the project's own canonical implementations
